items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know the girl who’s working with him. Her name is Maureen – let’s see. Maureen. I had it just a moment – Sickler.

ctx.x: And then he’d go – but Rudy, Rudy was a guy that – he would tell you straight up. “Don’t touch my piano.” He said something that was funny. My guitar player – I can’t remember exactly what it was. The guy was sitting at the piano. He says – what’d he say? “That piano is for piano players.” But it was funnier than that. I remember the way he – he’s very, very clever in his choice of words, too. I’ve been around Rudy multiple times. I remember his wife Elvira – I think her name was Elvie [Elva], who passed away.…
